description: Print a business card for an agent from its own name, description, colour and picture. Returns the agent's .fafa (FAF Agent file) and a link that opens its card. Nothing is stored: the .fafa travels in the link. The card says "self-declared" because nothing is checked against a repo.

accent.description: The card colour as a hex, e.g. "#7c3aed". Optional; none means ink (black or white).

description.description: What the agent does, in one line, up to 140 characters. Optional.

icon.description: An https link to a picture for the logo spot, e.g. "https://example.com/me.png". Optional; none means the monogram. A square PNG (256 x 256, transparent background) or an SVG looks best.

name.description: The agent's name, up to 100 characters.

name: faf_business_card
title: Print a business card for an agent
